title: Video configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.VideoAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

Autoplay.description: Starts playback automatically (browsers may require Muted).

Captions.description: JSON list of caption tracks: [{ LanguageCode, SourceFile, Label }].

Loop.description: Restarts playback when the video ends.

URL.description: Video source: a URL or a base64 data URL.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
